summary: Software Engineer with 2.5 years of experience building applied AI systems, backend tooling, and engineering distributed enterprise platforms across 90+ client environments.

projects.name: Centralized Continuous Monitoring (CCM)
achievements: Engineered centralized ETL architecture as sole engineer, resolving production reliability failures across 90+ enterprise client environments.
Accelerated client deployment speed, achieving a 98% overall onboarding reduction (15 days to <3 hours) across two architectural iterations.
Owned engineering coordination for production onboarding across 90+ enterprise environments with zero dedicated support staff.
Authored complete product TDD and user documentation, reducing support tickets and engineering dependency.
Spearheaded strategic migration of 7 enterprise ETL workflows from legacy SSIS to a Kubernetes-backed Spark platform, achieving a 40% reduction in data processing time.

projects.name: DSL Tooling Engine
achievements: Architected a grammar-driven log obfuscation engine (ANTLR) that resolved a compliance-critical deployment blocker for over 15 enterprise clients.
Formulated a grammar-driven query decomposition engine (ANTLR) powering performance recommendations and QA user-journey reconstruction.
Received Q1 2026 Spot Award for obfuscator delivery and orchestration migration leadership.

projects.name: Entity Ranking & Semantic Context Generation
achievements: Engineered an agentic data pipeline transforming metadata and usage logs across 4 entity types into a structured semantic knowledge layer.
Constructed a PageRank-based entity ranking engine on a bipartite graph combining structural connectivity with usage scoring across 4 enterprise clients.
Implemented a two-pass LLM pipeline generating a domain-grounded semantic model (15-cluster knowledge layer).
Developed a skills-based agent framework with deterministic reasoning and runtime semantic retrieval, driving a 60% reduction in query resolution time.
Restructured platform deployment topology by building API extraction layers for centralized raw-data ingestion, eliminating per-client deployment overhead.
